description: Table 'assets' has a 'status' lifecycle column but no direct FK to an event table. State transitions are implicit — the history of state changes is not tracked in the ontology.
remediation: Create or link to a domain_events entry when status changes. Model the transition as a DomainEvent subclass in the ontology.
